events.title: Demo update: Windows title screen
events.summary: Some Windows players are seeing a dark title screen instead of the 3D village. We're working on a fix and will post here when it's in.Thanks for your patience.

events.title: SUNSTONE demo, live during Next Fest
events.summary: We are streaming the SUNSTONE demo on this page during Steam Next Fest: Sunhome, the Old Wood and the first tomb, The Hollow. The demo is free, so you can play it right now. Full game Nov 11.

events.title: The SUNSTONE demo is out now for Steam Next Fest
events.summary: The SUNSTONE demo is live on Steam for Next Fest. You start in Sunhome, take the wood road through the Old Wood to the Hollow Oak, and go down into the first tomb, The Hollow.The guardian at the bottom is Hornhead. Your sword only sparks off him while he's wrapped, so you'll need to work out how to get fire onto him first. events.title: The SUNSTONE demo is out: play The Hollow in your browser
events.summary: The SUNSTONE demo went up this week on itch.io. It covers the first tomb, The Hollow, from the prologue through the Hornhead fight, with two hidden cellars to find along the way. You can get the first Sunstone and a clue to where you’re headed next.Play it in your browser: https://quorumgames.itch.io/sunstone-demoIt’s playable right there in the tab.
